articles.title: Sands China Co-organises Inclusive Community Event with UGAMM
articles.rawDate: Oct.21 Sands China Co-organises Inclusive Community Event with UGAMM
articles.summary: Sands China donated MOP240,000 to the Peng On Tung Charity Foundation at a Saturday event co-organised with UGAMM, its 17th consecutive annual gift. The donation supports tele-assistance for 850 financially disadvantaged seniors plus home-repair and elderly-haircut programmes; 200 seniors and young volunteers joined intergenerational activities.

articles.title: SJM Macao Open 2026 Brings World-Class Golf to the Wider Community
articles.summary: After the SJM Macao Open 2026 (15–18 October), SJM ran community golf activities that took the tournament beyond the course — Fun Days at Anim’Arte NAM VAN drew close to 1,200 people. SJM also hosted student clinics with touring professionals, university behind-the-scenes tours, and a Walk Like a Champion course walk for about 35 seniors from Caritas Macau.

articles.title: ‘NBA Cares x Sands Cares Community Impact Week 2026’ Attracts Over 2,900 Participants Across Five Days
articles.rawDate: Oct.15 ‘NBA Cares x Sands Cares Community Impact Week 2026’ Attracts Over 2,900 Participants Across Five Days
articles.summary: The NBA Cares x Sands Cares Community Impact Week 2026 (7–11 October) drew more than 2,900 participants, including NBA legends, Greater Bay Area students and Macao community groups. Organised by Sands China and NBA Cares around The NBA China Games 2026, the five-day programme used basketball clinics, school visits and a boxed-lunch distribution to promote youth development and inclusion.

articles.title: Argo at Four Seasons Hotel Hong Kong Celebrates Its Highest-Ever Ranking at No. 25 in the World’s 50 Best Bars 2026
articles.summary: ARGO at Four Seasons Hotel Hong Kong has been ranked No. 25 in The World’s 50 Best Bars 2026, marking its highest-ever position on the prestigious global list. ARGO is one of only four bars in Hong Kong recognized in the top 50 and the only hotel bar in the city to receive this honour.
